preconditions: A five-frame visual quiet baseline must be observed before creating a temporary preset.
The active configured source must deliver decoder-fresh frames through Toposync.
No PTZ status readback is used as exact-return proof.
recovery: Create one named temporary preset before movement. Issue Stop once, GoToPreset once, and preserve the preset if a quiet visual return differs from the baseline by more than 15 analysis pixels.
outcome: The five-frame quiet baseline and return windows passed. Return correspondence was verified with 591 inliers, 0.9969 overlap, and 0.0806 analysis-pixel displacement; the temporary preset was removed. The intentionally tiny pulse displaced only 0.189 analysis pixels and does not characterize local actuator response.
